capabilities: Display backlinks as a tree grouped by folder structure
Collapse and expand branches to focus on important references
Use a frontmatter property as the display name
Treat folder notes and index files as clickable folders
extras: README documents all settings in a table and one command, but notes the motivation more than limits or troubleshooting.
intentEvidence: Here's a comparison of the core plugin vs the hierarchical backlinks plugin in action.
motivation: The author organizes notes into high-level directories and wanted a backlinks overview like the tag-hierarchy view but based on folder structure.
problem: Obsidian's core backlinks pane shows references as a flat list, so users who organize notes into folders get no structural overview of where backlinks come from.

relations.evidence: This is how the out-of-the-box core backlinks plugin displays backlinks

summary: Backlinks panel that groups references to the active note into a collapsible tree based on the folder structure of the linking files.
